sections.description: Affiliate catalog data and Amazon Creators API synchronization.
sections.changelog:
= 0.3.11 =
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.

= 0.3.10 =
* Use the same simple affiliate-link instruction for new and saved Amazon items.

= 0.3.9 =
* Simplify product editor help and remove outdated save-first image instructions.
* Keep reference details under Advanced and hide saved status while editing.

= 0.3.8 =
* Keep the pasted affiliate URL as the product card destination instead of substituting the API URL.

* Preview Amazon product images when pasting full or short links without changing saved product content.
* Refresh Amazon details during explicit saves so new items do not depend on cron or a manual refresh.

= 0.3.7 =
* Follow the amzlinks.in redirect used by link.amazon so product image lookup works from staging servers.

= 0.3.6 =
* Recognize link.amazon product links and resolve their product identity for automatic Amazon image sync while preserving the original affiliate URL.

= 0.3.5 =
* Show missing credentials and authentication failures clearly on shop admin screens without exposing secrets.
* Preserve destination product content and existing automatic refresh behavior.
